articles.title: Lundin Mining Announces Vicuña Integrated Technical Study Results Highlighting a World-Class Mining District
articles.mainIdea: Lundin Mining Announces Vicuña Integrated Technical Study Results Highlighting a World-Class Mining District
articles.summary: CNW Group: Lundin Mining Announces Vicuña Integrated Technical Study Results Highlighting a World-Class Mining District. (TSX: LUN) (Nasdaq Stockholm: LUMI) Lundin Mining Corporation ("Lundin Mining" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the results of the integrated technical study (the Preliminary Economic Assessment "PEA" or the "Study") for the Vicuña project (the "Vicuña Project" or the "Project"). The Vicuña Project is comprised of the Filo del Sol deposit and the Josemaria deposit and is held by Vicuña Corp. ("Vicuña"), a 50/50 joint arrangement between Lundin Mining and BHP. Unless otherwise indicated, Related tickers mentioned: LUNMF.

articles.title: 'Tehran' TV series producer Dana Eden found dead in Athens
articles.mainIdea: 'Tehran' TV series producer Dana Eden found dead in Athens
articles.summary: AFP: 'Tehran' TV series producer Dana Eden found dead in Athens. TV producer Dana Eden, who co-created the hit Israeli spy thriller series "Tehran", has been found dead in a hotel room in Athens, Greek police told AFP on Monday.The 52-year-old Israeli national's body was found Sunday night at a hotel near Syntagma Square, in the heart of the Greek capital, the force said.
